lead: Everything a school or club needs to run a National Space Day event, held on 23 August. That is the day in 2023 when India's Vikram lander touched down near the Moon's south pole.
try: Press Start show mode to put the event on the big screen. It steps the room through each lab and quiz round, with a timer and team scores.
points: The event takes an hour and a half and mixes four labs with three quiz rounds: land Vikram, escape a failing rocket in India's Gaganyaan capsule, read the live Sun and meet the old astronomer Aryabhata.
Short on time? Drop the third lab and its quiz round, and the event still works in an hour.
Under Certificates, type a name and print a certificate for everyone who took part. Names stay on your computer and nothing is sent anywhere.
